title: Feather Trim Deep-V Maternity Photoshoot Robe Gown
seo_title: Feather Trim Deep-V Maternity Robe Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Deep-V maternity photoshoot robe gown with feather trim, long bell sleeves and a tie belt. 6 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: an open-front robe-style gown with a deep V neckline, long wide bell sleeves and soft feather trim along the cuffs and hem. Tie the belt above the bump or leave it open for a flowing, dramatic look.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 10 days, so please allow about 22-26 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
deep V neckline, open front with a tie belt, long wide bell sleeves, a floor-length flowing skirt, and feather trim on the cuffs, front edges and hem.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Blush Pink, White, Black, Burgundy, Forest Green and Champagne Gold.
Dry clean recommended; spot clean gently around the feather trim and hang to dry. Steam on low, away from the trim.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot. The open front and tie belt leave room for the bump; choose by your bust.
garment_lock: a floor-length open-front robe-style maternity gown in satin-look fabric with a deep V neckline, a tie belt at the waist, long wide bell-shaped sleeves, and a flowing full-length skirt, with soft feather trim running along the sleeve cuffs, front edges and hem

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Feather Trim Deep-V Maternity Photoshoot Robe Gown", in BLUSH PINK (a soft peachy pink).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a floor-length open-front robe-style maternity gown in satin-look fabric with a deep V neckline, a tie belt at the waist, long wide bell-shaped sleeves, and a flowing full-length skirt, with soft feather trim running along the sleeve cuffs, front edges and hem. The feather trim is the same blush pink as the gown.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this robe gown open at the front with the belt tied loosely under the bust, one hand on her bump, the other holding a sleeve out so the feather trim shows; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an elegant indoor maternity shoot beside a tall window with soft golden light, the wide bell sleeves and feather-trimmed hem moving gently; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The robe gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, hem spread around the base, showing the deep V neckline, tie belt, bell sleeves and feather trim clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: blush pink colour (soft peachy pink), deep V neckline, open-front robe shape with a tie belt at the waist, long wide bell sleeves, floor-length flowing skirt, and soft feather trim in the same blush pink on the cuffs, front edges and hem. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
